{{Top|leg}}
'''Protato wedges''' were a way of serving [[Protato/Legends|protatos]] in which the vegetables were sliced into small wedges. They were served as a lunch side at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] District on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was priced at 3.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
